skills.name: Markman's Creed
lore: Your bullets deal increased damage based on travel distance.
The farther the shot, the deadlier the impact.

skills.name: Piercing Combo
lore: Unleash a relentless bullet sequence that escalates with each strike:
First Strike: Fire a precise bullet.
Second Strike: Shoot two rapid rounds in quick succession.
Third Strike: Unleash six consecutive shots.
Fourth Strike: Charge a devastating shockwave bullet and fire
it forward. Deals higher damage and penetrates through enemies.
Flame Cannon (Overheated): Fire an explosive infernal cannon blast
where explosions erupt in a straight line like a burning laser,
scorching everything in its path and leaving enemies aflame.

skills.name: Hellflare Burst
lore: Charge and release a wide, long-range shotgun blast.

skills.name: Deathmark
lore: Mark up to 9 enemies within 30 blocks. After a short delay,
execution bullets fire into all marked targets at once.

skills.name: Overheat
lore: Your weapon overheats for 10 seconds. You gain Slowness II,
and Piercing Combo transforms into Flame Cannon.

skills.name: Skyfall Barrage
lore: Fire into the air to call down 8 missile strikes on random
enemies nearby. Each missile explodes and burns targets on impact.

skills.name: Vermilion Execution
lore: Create a large strike zone at the targeted location. Bullet rain
continuously assaults enemies inside for 4 seconds, ending
with 8 massive missiles crashing down, exploding and burning
